newsitem.title: UK: UK shares rise, lifted by Halifax float.
newsitem.headline: UK shares rise, lifted by Halifax float.

text.p: UK's leading blue chip shares rebounded on Monday, lifted by a sharp rebound in the bank sector as Halifax Building Society Plc floated its shares.
At 0743 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 share index was up 15.4 points at 4,636.7, as advancers beat decliners 62 to 28.
Shares in Halifax, Britain's largest mortgage lender, started their first day of trade on the London Stock Exchange at 774-1/2p, sparking a sectorwide rally.
The flotation, said one senior dealer, "should help the bank sector, but there are fears that the bubble will soon burst."
